# Little Day Out

> > Little Day Out is Singapore's go-to family guide for activities, events, attractions, dining, and parenting tips across the island.

Little Day Out curates family-friendly experiences across Singapore, covering everything from major attractions like Gardens by the Bay and Sentosa to neighborhood playgrounds, seasonal festivals, dining spots, and parenting advice. The site helps families discover both popular destinations and hidden gems for quality time with children.

## Key Topics

- Family activities in Singapore
- Kids activities and playgrounds
- Gardens by the Bay events
- Chinese New Year 2026 celebrations
- Singapore attractions and events
- School holiday programs
- Family dining in Singapore
- HDB malls and neighborhoods
- Seasonal festivals (Christmas, Hari Raya, National Day)
- Wildlife parks and nature experiences
- Parenting tips and advice
- Indoor play centers
- Cultural experiences and heritage trails
- Eco-friendly family activities

## Major Attractions & Seasonal Events

- [Christmas Wonderland 2025 At Gardens By The Bay: Singapore's First-Ever Christmas Pyramid & More From 29 Nov To 1 Jan](https://www.littledayout.com/christmas-wonderland-gardens-by-the-bay): Christmas Wonderland 2025 at Gardens by the Bay with festive attractions
- [Geylang Serai Hari Raya Bazaar 2026 Guide: Food & Things To Do](https://www.littledayout.com/geylang-serai-hari-raya-ramadan-bazaar-guide): Complete guide to Geylang Serai Ramadan Bazaar 2026 food and activities
- [NDP Flypast 2025: Flag Flypast Routes On National Day, Air Participation & Fighter Jet Flypast](https://www.littledayout.com/ndp-flypast-fighter-jet-fly-flag-route-singapore-national-day): National Day Parade 2025 flypast routes and fighter jet participation
- [Petals Of Friendship At Floral Fantasy: My Little Pony At Gardens By The Bay](https://www.littledayout.com/petals-of-friendship-floral-fantasy-my-little-pony-gardens-by-the-bay): My Little Pony exhibition at Floral Fantasy, Gardens by the Bay
- [Jewel Celebrates The Magic Of Adventure With Disney Cruise Line From 5 Nov To 4 Jan](https://www.littledayout.com/jewel-celebrates-the-magic-of-adventure-with-disney-cruise-line): Disney Cruise Line festive celebration at Jewel Changi Airport
- [Togetherland By World Christmas Market 2025: Festive Treats And Fun For Families & Pets](https://www.littledayout.com/togetherland-world-christmas-market-festive): Pet-friendly Christmas market at Bayfront Event Space with local artisans

## Chinese New Year 2026 Celebrations

- [Have A Horse-picious Chinese New Year 2026 At Singapore Zoo & Other Wildlife Parks](https://www.littledayout.com/wild-cny-chinese-new-year-singapore-zoo-wildlife-parks): Chinese New Year 2026 celebrations at Mandai Wildlife Reserve parks
- [Museum Roundtable Lunar New Year Hongbao Campaign 2026: Collect Year Of The Horse Red Packets From 23 Jan To 15 Feb](https://www.littledayout.com/museum-roundtable-lunar-new-year-hongbao-campaign): National Heritage Board's Year of the Horse hongbao campaign across museums

## School Holiday Programs & Activities

- [Camp Asia Magical Winter Camp](https://www.littledayout.com/camp-asia-magical-winter-camp): Camp Asia winter holiday programs with STEM, arts and sports for ages 3-16
- [SG60 Green Playground At UOL Malls From 18 July To 17 August: KINEX, United Square & Velocity@Novena Square](https://www.littledayout.com/sg60-green-playground-uol-malls-kinex-united-square-velocity-novena-square): SG60 recycled cardboard playground at KINEX, United Square & Velocity malls
